text: | Time (seven_guis timer) | `TimerTicks`, provided in context by every headless-stand boot, replaces the timer's 100 ms `futures_timer::Delay`: each `deliver(n)` tick is one 0.1 s step capped at the duration, applied on the next pass — a `pump`, an input helper's own pump, or a settle (`Harness::settle`, `Session::act`, each acting verb of `Session::run`) — so a delivery made before an input helper is applied by that helper's pump and one made after it by nothing until a later pass; settle neither advances the timer nor waits on a tick not yet delivered; an undelivered source holds elapsed at 0.0 s; the driver moves that time by `advance`, which moves the session's clock — the harness's `VirtualClock`, the clock every harness-built document reads — by exactly `ms` inside one settled step, then hands `ms` to the step: `seven_guis::stand::timer_step(ticks)` is the step the Timer's session carries through `Session::with_time` — it returns nothing and delivers the whole 100 ms ticks (`TIMER_TICK_MS`) the asks hold, carrying the remainder below one tick across calls (250 then 250 → 2 then 3 ticks); `advanced_ms` is exactly `ms`, the clock's move (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18), not what the Timer's counter gained — 60000 is reported while the elapsed display stops at its 15 s duration | (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/timer.rs:10-20; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/timer.rs:47-55; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_timer.rs:7-46; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_settle.rs:35-76; examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:85-102; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_timer.rs:1-12; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-settle-detection/evidence/red-first.md, the driver's `advance` at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-act-by-id/report.md, on the one clock at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-18-one-virtual-clock/report.md) |

- **Engine features by runner:** the two runners build the same test file against different engine features: `cargo test --workspace --locked` (CI's test leg, `ci-leg.sh fast`) resolves the whole workspace, where `blitz`'s default `tracing` feature turns on `blitz-shell/tracing` and `blitz-html/tracing` and each of those `blitz-dom/tracing`, so blitz-dom is built for that invocation with its `tracing` call sites compiled in — for blitz-tests, as the event below shows, and by the same resolved graph for the seven_guis binaries the invocation builds (read from the graph, not on a binary); `cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked` (what `agent-run.sh run` and a per-file gate run) and a `-p seven_guis` build leave it off (packages/blitz/Cargo.toml:14; packages/blitz/Cargo.toml:18; packages/blitz-shell/Cargo.toml:21; packages/blitz-html/Cargo.toml:15; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/evidence/feature-unification.md, from cargo's resolved feature graph). Under the workspace build the engine logs one INFO event beside a driver `type`, which escher's sink prints as `INFO blitz_dom::document … message=[redacted]`: the same check file read green under `-p blitz-tests` and red under the workspace leg, so a check that reads a sink's capture counts lines by target, never in total, and a green per-package run is not the workspace leg's green (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md).

Since 2026-10-17-upstream-sync-engine-debts both `cargo llvm-cov` lines take `--ignore-filename-regex 'keyboard_compat\.rs$'`, excluding dioxus-native-dom's crate-private `keyboard_compat.rs` — upstream's temporary keyboard-types 0.7/0.8 bridge, 564 lines whose 530 conversion arms no test of ours reaches — until upstream retires it, on the operator's P4 answer (inputs#I2 of that chunk); the floors and `coverage_floor.py` are unchanged; at the merged tree dioxus-native-dom reads 2472/2934 = 84.25 % (equal to the baseline), escher-driver 98.19 %, blitz-test-harness 91.69 %, the leg ending `coverage floor: 3 of 3 crates at or above their floors` with no `keyboard_compat` record in `target/coverage/lcov.info`; the exclusion is pinned by `test_coverage_leg_reaches_the_floor_on_each_crate` asserting `--ignore-filename-regex` among the leg's words (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:41-42; .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:44-45; .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:327 — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-17-upstream-sync-engine-debts/report.md).
 A `*_tests.rs` `#[path]` test-child file is no record of the per-crate reading — the coverage job's per-file report lists none, `mcp_tests.rs` and `schema_tests.rs` included — so a test module moved out of line moves its crate's reading with no line of code changed: since 2026-10-19-test-splits escher-driver read 4266/4350 = 98.07 %, since 2026-10-19-visual-lint, which added lint.rs, 4634/4732 = 97.93 %, and since 2026-10-20-load-wait it reads 4695/4794 = 97.93 %, the 97 % floor holding, 3 of 3 crates still at or above their floors (as measured at the `Coverage report` job of CI#39360124515, read in escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-20-load-wait/evidence/ci.md)
